exact: negative regulation of DNA-dependent transcription, termination
negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription, termination
negative regulation of termination of DNA-dependent transcription
negative regulation of transcription termination, DNA-dependent

definition: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of DNA-dependent transcription termination, the process in which transcription is completed; the formation of phosphodiester bonds ceases, the RNA-DNA hybrid dissociates, and RNA polymerase releases the DNA.
label: negative regulation of termination of DNA-templated transcription
